facts.title: Validated PostgreSQL runtime
facts.content: FORGE is compatible with PostgreSQL 14 or newer and was physically validated on PostgreSQL 18.4.
facts.es: ¿En qué versión real de PostgreSQL se validó FORGE?
facts.en: Which actual PostgreSQL version was FORGE validated on?

facts.title: Validated pgvector runtime
facts.content: The optional vector migration was validated with pgvector 0.8.2 and remains separate from the relational Core migration.
facts.es: ¿Qué versión de pgvector se probó y cómo se separa del Core?
facts.en: Which pgvector version was tested and how is it separated from Core?

facts.title: Managed document identity
facts.content: A document forge_id becomes immutable while the document is MANAGED; conflict resolution may still assign identity before that state.
facts.es: ¿Cuándo se vuelve inmutable el forge_id de un documento?
facts.en: When does a document forge_id become immutable?

facts.title: Duplicate identity conflicts
facts.content: Duplicate document identity is represented explicitly with CONFLICT state instead of violating the unique managed identity invariant.
facts.es: ¿Cómo se representan las identidades de documento duplicadas?
facts.en: How are duplicate document identities represented?

facts.title: Project isolation boundary
facts.content: Every scoped relation and semantic read enforces project identity, preventing references or search results from crossing projects.
facts.es: ¿Qué impide que una búsqueda devuelva conocimiento de otro proyecto?
facts.en: What prevents search from returning knowledge from another project?

facts.title: Optimistic locking
facts.content: Mutable FORGE entities require the current expectedVersion; concurrent stale updates fail with an optimistic lock error.
facts.es: ¿Qué ocurre si actualizo una entidad con una versión antigua?
facts.en: What happens when an entity is updated with an old version?

facts.title: Append-only ledgers
facts.content: Context packages, events and audit log rows reject application UPDATE and DELETE operations and remain append-only.
facts.es: ¿Qué tablas de trazabilidad no permiten UPDATE ni DELETE?
facts.en: Which traceability tables reject UPDATE and DELETE?

facts.title: Immutable embedding history
facts.content: Embeddings are append-only per profile, source and source version; a changed source creates a new vector record rather than overwriting history.
facts.es: ¿Se sobrescribe el vector cuando cambia una memoria?
facts.en: Is a vector overwritten when a memory changes?

facts.title: Embedding dimensions
facts.content: The database and Gateway reject vectors whose dimensions differ from the registered embedding profile.
facts.es: ¿Quién rechaza un vector con dimensiones incorrectas?
facts.en: Who rejects a vector with dimensions that do not match its profile?

facts.title: Recommended multilingual model
facts.content: Qwen3 Embedding 0.6B Q8 is the recommended local multilingual profile with 1024 dimensions.
facts.es: ¿Qué modelo multilingüe local y cuántas dimensiones recomienda FORGE?
facts.en: Which local multilingual model and dimensionality does FORGE recommend?

facts.title: Nomic baseline
facts.content: Nomic Embed Text v1.5 Q4 is retained as a lightweight English and integration baseline with 768 dimensions.
facts.es: ¿Qué modelo ligero se conserva como baseline en inglés?
facts.en: Which lightweight model remains the English baseline?

facts.title: Qwen query transform
facts.content: The Qwen retrieval instruction and Query prefix are immutable query-side profile metadata and must match the indexed vector space.
facts.es: ¿Dónde se fija la instrucción de consulta de Qwen?
facts.en: Where is the Qwen query instruction fixed?

facts.title: Document input transform
facts.content: Provider-specific document prefixes are applied before embedding and bound to immutable profile identity, never hidden inside FORGE Core.
facts.es: ¿Cómo se tratan los prefijos específicos del proveedor al indexar documentos?
facts.en: How are provider-specific document prefixes handled during indexing?

facts.title: External provider boundary
facts.content: Embedding generation stays outside FORGE Core behind a replaceable provider adapter; the database stores vectors but never calls a model.
facts.es: ¿La base de datos llama directamente al modelo de embeddings?
facts.en: Does the database call the embedding model directly?

facts.title: Semantic text bridge
facts.content: The external semantic bridge exposes forge_search_text, embeds natural language, then delegates the vector search to the project-scoped Gateway.
facts.es: ¿Qué componente convierte una pregunta textual en búsqueda vectorial?
facts.en: Which component converts a text question into vector search?

facts.title: Provider-agnostic Core MCP
facts.content: The Core MCP forge_semantic_search accepts a precomputed vector and deliberately contains no LM Studio or Qwen dependency.
facts.es: ¿Qué recibe forge_semantic_search del MCP Core?
facts.en: What does the Core MCP forge_semantic_search accept?

facts.title: Exact semantic search
facts.content: FORGE currently uses exact project-scoped vector scans; ANN indexes are deferred until measured volume justifies profile-specific tuning.
facts.es: ¿Por qué todavía no se usan índices ANN?
facts.en: Why are ANN indexes not used yet?

facts.title: Worker idempotency
facts.content: Worker write keys hash profile, source kind, source ID, source version and input hash, making retries deterministic and replay-safe.
facts.es: ¿De qué datos depende la clave idempotente del worker?
facts.en: Which data determines the worker idempotency key?

facts.title: Bounded candidate pagination
facts.content: The embedding worker consumes deterministic candidate pages of at most 50 texts and returns a cursor when its run budget is exhausted.
facts.es: ¿Cómo limita el worker el trabajo de cada ejecución?
facts.en: How does the worker bound work in each execution?

facts.title: Transient provider retries
facts.content: The worker retries only transient provider failures such as 408, 429, server errors, timeouts and network failures with bounded backoff.
facts.es: ¿Qué errores del proveedor reintenta automáticamente el worker?
facts.en: Which provider errors does the worker retry automatically?

facts.title: Windows incremental schedule
facts.content: Windows runs a bounded idempotent Qwen indexing cycle at user logon and every minute instead of keeping a fragile desktop child alive.
facts.es: ¿Cada cuánto se ejecuta la indexación automática en Windows?
facts.en: How often does automatic indexing run on Windows?

facts.title: Atomic worker health
facts.content: The latest indexing cycle writes sanitized atomic JSON health to APPDATA FORGE embedding-worker-status.json.
facts.es: ¿Dónde puedo consultar el último estado del indexador?
facts.en: Where can the latest indexer status be inspected?

facts.title: DPAPI credential storage
facts.content: The PostgreSQL runtime password is encrypted for the current Windows user with DPAPI and decrypted only into process memory.
facts.es: ¿Cómo se protege la contraseña de PostgreSQL usada por Codex?
facts.en: How is the PostgreSQL password used by Codex protected?

facts.title: Least-privilege runtime
facts.content: MCP, worker and validation use the limited forge_test_runner database role rather than the PostgreSQL administrator account.
facts.es: ¿Qué rol de base de datos usan los procesos normales de FORGE?
facts.en: Which database role do normal FORGE processes use?

facts.title: Migration checksums
facts.content: Schema migrations are transactional, ordered and checksum-verified; replay with identical content is idempotent and drift fails closed.
facts.es: ¿Cómo detecta FORGE que una migración aplicada fue modificada?
facts.en: How does FORGE detect that an applied migration was modified?

facts.title: Optional vector migration
facts.content: The relational Core can be installed and tested without pgvector; vector objects are introduced only by the separate optional migration.
facts.es: ¿Puedo instalar el Core sin tener pgvector?
facts.en: Can Core be installed without pgvector?

facts.title: Context package staleness
facts.content: Loading an immutable context package compares recorded source versions with current versions and reports stale sources without mutating the package.
facts.es: ¿Cómo detecta un paquete de contexto que sus fuentes cambiaron?
facts.en: How does a context package detect that its sources changed?

facts.title: Deferred historical revisions
facts.content: Mutable domain rows do not preserve full historical snapshots; strict entity revision tables remain intentionally deferred beyond the MVP.
facts.es: ¿FORGE conserva hoy todas las revisiones históricas de una decisión?
facts.en: Does FORGE currently preserve every historical revision of a decision?

facts.title: Gateway JSON contracts
facts.content: Rich JSONB payload shapes are validated at the typed Gateway boundary while the database enforces durable relational invariants.
facts.es: ¿Dónde se validan las formas complejas de los payloads JSONB?
facts.en: Where are complex JSONB payload shapes validated?

facts.title: LM Studio loopback endpoint
facts.content: The validated local embedding endpoint is LM Studio on http://127.0.0.1:1234/v1; plain HTTP is accepted only for loopback development.
facts.es: ¿Qué endpoint local usa LM Studio y por qué permite HTTP?
facts.en: Which local LM Studio endpoint is used and why is HTTP allowed?
